name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: Login codes, email verification, and device pairing.

motionProfile.reason: One group entrance, per-slot state paint and changed-character replacements keep the single native input and its caret untouched.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Input OTP owns one opacity entrance on a later-inserted slot group; hidden, inert and unusable groups keep native paint.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Each slot owns its own border, background and character foreground; invalid state, DOM focus-within and unverified palettes settle that paint immediately.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Only the character whose code position changed is replaced inside its fixed box; the real input keeps caret, selection, composition and paste.
